resize_detector_outputs: resize R-CNN detector output instances to match the desired output resolution
scale_prediction_boxes: scale and clip prediction boxes then filter empty boxes from detector results
convert_roi_masks_to_bitmasks: convert ROIMasks prediction masks to bitmasks at the target output resolution
scale_keypoints: scale predicted keypoints by x and y scale factors to match output resolution
resize_semantic_seg_predictions: resize semantic segmentation logits to the original image resolution using bilinear interpolation
